name: ko_reset
description: The KO status reset (0x79a190) and the death check (0x78c740): the status words, counters, stage stacks, buff byte and pools of one character before and after, and for the death check which kind it ran, the Overkill flag and whether the Auto-Life revive was queued. REAL machine code run in an x86-32 emulator.

function.signature: ko_reset(int id, int keepBits) -> int, death_check(int killer, int victim, int noRewards, int poseFlag) -> int

harness.note: the real machine code; the death check hooks the presentation, statistics, queue, loot, capture, Overdrive-death and pose helpers it calls (the FFX-G02 set) and the Auto-Life queue call is recorded

notes: ko_reset: in/out hold perm (Chr+0x606), counters (0x608..0x614, 13), extra (0x616), stacks (0x65e..0x663, 6), buff (0x640), hp (0x5d0), mp (0x5d4), maxHp (0x594), maxMp (0x598), baseHp (0x59c), baseMp (0x5a0), autoB (0x6be); in.arg is the second argument (the bits of the permanent word kept).

death_check: in adds victim, killer, noRewards (third argument), exists (Chr+0x10), dead (Chr+0xdcc), eject (Chr+0x617 bit 0), monsterFlag (Chr+0x3f5), overkillCounter (Chr+0xf60, signed), debugNoOverkill (global 0x112a914); out adds dead, kind (Chr+0x702), overkillFlag (Chr+0xf5f), autoLifeQueued (the Auto-Life command 0x311f was queued), cancelled (the victim's queued actions were cancelled); ret is the return value.
